title: A24 is having a great year at the box office. That could give HBO Max a streaming edge
summary: A24 is experiencing a remarkable year at the box office, driven by the success of films such as "Backrooms," "The Drama," and the documentary about Elizabeth Holmes titled "You Can See Everything." This surge in box office performance could potentially enhance HBO Max's competitive edge in the streaming market. As A24 continues to release critically acclaimed content, it may influence viewer preferences and subscription trends on streaming platforms.
